sentences.en: His eldest SOH, Heinrich August Hahn (1821-1861), after studying theology at Breslau and Berlin, became successively Privatdozent at Breslau (1845), professor ad interim (1846) at Konigsberg on the death of Heinrich Havernick, professor extraordinarius (1851) and professor ordinarius (1860) at Greif swald.
sentences.vi: SOH anh cả của ông, Heinrich August Hahn (1821-1861), sau khi học thần học tại Breslau và Berlin, kế tiếp trở thành Privatdozent tại Breslau (1845), giáo sư lâm thời (1846) tại Konigsberg sau cái chết của Heinrich Havernick, giáo sư phụ tá (1851) và giáo sư ordinarius (1860) tại Greif swald.

sentences.en: His SOH, George Friedrich Wilhelm (1832-1900), born on the 31st of December 1832, at Hamburg, was astronomer at the observatory at Durham, England, from 1853 to 1856.

sentences.en: His SOH, David Schley Schaff (1852-), was professor of church history in Lane Theological Seminary in 1897-1903, and after 1903 in Western Theological Seminary at Allegheny, Pa.

sentences.en: In this paper, based on HDLC protocols, we propose a novel interface scheme to deal with section overhead (SOH) in data communication channel (DCC), which is used in SDH processors development.
